name: Mentions
summary: A text area where typing "@" suggests people to mention: keep typing to narrow the list, choose one, and their name is written into the text after the "@". For comments, messages and notes that notify or credit someone. Not for picking people as a field's value (use a Combobox or TagInput).
a11y: The text area is the WAI-ARIA APG combobox (`aria-autocomplete="list"`) for a listbox of people that opens in the top layer under it; the highlighted person is `aria-activedescendant`, so focus never leaves the text. Each person reads as name and role. When no one matches, the list says so. The text itself stays plain: a mention is "@" and the name, read as written.

keys.action: close the suggestions and keep typing

props.name: people
props.description: The people who can be mentioned. Suggestions show those whose name contains what follows the trigger.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The character that starts a mention: `@` (default), or `#` for topics.

props.name: onMentionsChange
props.description: Called with the people the text mentions now, whenever that changes.

props.name: limit
props.description: How many suggestions show at most. Default 6.

props.name: name
props.description: Their name, written into the text after the trigger: "@Mira Okafor".

props.name: secondary
props.description: One line under the name in the suggestions: a role or a team.
